readings.Aries: Someone needs your energy aimed at them in a supportive direction, not a directive one. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Taurus: The waiting you've been doing is almost over. You will need to be ready to move. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Gemini: There is a thread you dropped three weeks ago that still leads somewhere worth going. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Cancer: The dream you're not taking seriously is the dream you should take seriously. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Leo: Your joy is contagious and you've been keeping it to yourself. Release some of it. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Virgo: You've been useful. You've been reliable. Today something needs you to be present rather than productive. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Libra: Something in your life has drifted out of alignment. Your instinct for it is excellent. Trust it. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Scorpio: There is something you need to grieve before you can desire again. Let yourself. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Sagittarius: The truth you're telling is true. It is not the whole truth. Find the rest of it. Let this one be easy.
readings.Capricorn: There is something in your life that has been postponed in service of the goal. Reschedule it. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Aquarius: The cause you've committed to is real. Make sure the commitment hasn't become an identity without a practice. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Pisces: You've given this situation your full emotional presence for a long time. A little more and it shifts. Saying less will move this further than saying more.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
